breakpoint.note: Lightning Bolt is the filler with Chain Lightning woven on cooldown. As spell power scales, Chain Lightning's higher per-cast damage makes it increasingly worth casting on every cooldown - a near-zero Chain Lightning count usually means DPS left on the table.

advisory: Keep Flame Shock ticking and weave Chain Lightning on cooldown between Lightning Bolt fillers; watch mana and drop Mana Spring / use Bloodlust windows for burst. Fight notes: Chain Lightning shines on add-heavy pulls (Karathress, Hyjal trash, Kael adds) where it can hit multiple targets - prioritize it there over single-target rotation. On movement-heavy fights (Vashj striders, Solarian) Flame Shock uptime suffers, so refresh it the moment you have a free GCD, and on pure single-target tank-and-spank keep Chain Lightning every cooldown rather than overcapping on Lightning Bolt.
